description: This file defines the EditReminderViewModel class, which manages reminder data, handles operations like insert, delete, update, and sets reminder date/time in the context of an Android application using MVVM architecture.

classes.name: EditReminderViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel for editing reminders, handling CRUD operations and date management.

methods.name: insertReminder
methods.description: Inserts a new reminder into the repository and schedules it.

methods.name: deleteReminder
methods.description: Deletes a reminder from the repository and cancels its schedule.

methods.name: updateReminder
methods.description: Updates an existing reminder and reschedules it.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date for the reminder with specified or default parameters.
